funnel_levels.L0_exposure_delivered: frozen discovery text byte-identical in the cell invocation (--append-system-prompt token pair) and the CLI accepted the invocation (completed with a valid stream); operationalizes TRANSPORT of the surface, not model attention
funnel_levels.L1_discovery_action: >=1 Bash tool_use command running `python -m provenlattice` together with `--help` or `-h`
funnel_levels.L2_CLI_invoked: >=1 Bash tool_use command containing `python -m provenlattice` (any arguments; superset of L1)
funnel_levels.L3_task_context_requested: >=1 such command whose arguments include the `task-context` subcommand
funnel_levels.L4_facts_returned: returned_facts >= 1 extracted by the frozen normalize_trace from a task-context-v0 payload
funnel_levels.L5_facts_used_proxy: preregistered PROXY (never causal evidence; always report as facts_used_proxy): the symbol token (last `:`-segment of a returned fact_id) appears in the final patch text or in a tool_use command issued after the first task-context-v0 tool_result

gate_reading_examples.B L4>0: CAPABILITY_REACHABLE (L5 remains an observation, not a requirement)

gates.GATE_CAPABILITY_REACHABLE: B L4 >= 1 -> CAPABILITY_REACHABLE (review may begin); B L4 == 0 -> CAPABILITY_INCONCLUSIVE
gates.GATE_DISCOVERY: B (L1 >= 1 or L2 >= 1); if both are 0 -> EXPOSURE_DELIVERED_BUT_NO_DISCOVERY_ACTION
gates.GATE_EXPOSURE_L0: L0 == 36/36 (transport integrity); any miss invalidates exposure analysis
gates.GATE_SELECTION: if discovery occurred and B L3 == 0 -> ADOPTION_GAP_AT_SELECTION
